title: Helicopters and amphibious vehicles

paragraphs.text: All letter companies received intensified helicopter training in the Camp Schwab and Northern Training Areas. All units received LVT training, covering the vehicles’ use in combat operations.

notes: Individual company training dates remain to be established.
